'''Flissar''' was a [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]] who worked as a caretaker at a warehouse in [[New Nystao]] on [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]] in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]]. [[Dal Konur]] broke into the warehouse by using a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] on Flissar and then stealing the Noghri's keys. He found the keys lieing on the ground near his workstation and then called the [[New Nystao police]] about it.

A group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] turned up shortly afterwards and Flissar refused them access into the warehouse.
